name: Sheared Hecke commutator at tau -> 0 and loading on X_0(4)(R) with Fricke w_4: closed (`c1-shear-hecke-fricke`, refereed once)
statement: [V_n, G_tau] = G_tau (exp(tau l (u + l)/4) - 1) V_n, l = log n (windowed L^2 norms; whole-line only for kappa-type kernels). The eigen-defect of 1 - lambda V_p has tau-order exactly 1 iff c(pm) = lambda c(m) for all m; zeta, zeta(s + a), completely multiplicative sign twists and unimodular twists all have order 1, so the statement is the identity "multiplicative at p", not an inequality. w_4 on the arc is u -> -u (evenness only). For tau < 0 the termwise prime expansion converges for a sign-twisted control as well; that it cannot be carried to tau = 0 is heuristic (Rodgers-Tao), not a theorem (row G22).

name: Window defect: commutator of the cutoff Q_c with Hecke operators
statement: (`c1-spinor-hecke-primitive` Lemma 5). For: it is the one place where a multiplicative mechanism acts on H_c non-trivially. Against: the formula is kernel-independent (holds for every control), so the function must enter through the test vector. Closed in round 2 (row G25, `c2-cutoff-hecke-defect`, refereed once): the form is the Weil form on a window; DH passes on every node set tried, the Liouville twist fails.
